runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged; no security can be bought
runs.entry: Price **none exists** (no security of the company can be bought: merged into ACP Crotona Merger Sub Corp., an affiliate of Argo Infrastructure Partners LP, effective 2022-07-06, for $24.75 a common share in cash, per the 8-K of 2022-07-06, 0001174947-22-000776; Form 15-12G of 2022-07-07, 0001174947-22-000800, one holder of record; the price feed returned HTTP 404; the company's website calls it wholly owned by Argo funds; $24.75 shown as history only). Shares 3,083,577 common on the covers of the 10-K for FY2021 and the 10-Q of 2022-05-12 (0001174947-22-000671), all held by ACP Crotona Corp. since 2022-07-06; `Screens/cover_shares.py` returned NOT AN SEC REGISTRANT. Sovereign for the earnings currency (USD) **5.43%**, US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-16. Read from the 10-K for FY2021 (0001174947-21-001128, filed 2021-12-17), the 10-Q to 2022-03-31, the 8-Ks of 2021-12-22 to 2022-07-06, the Form 15-12G, the DEFM14A of 2021-04-22 (0001174947-21-000427) and the 10-Ks for FY2016 to FY2020; one later fact (the July 2024 rate-case release) from the company's own website. Cross-check: FY2021 net income $1,524,903 and equity at 2021-09-30 $35,472,550 on the filed statements agree with the XBRL series. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: a franchised, rate-regulated gas and electric distributor; the New York Gas Company decides at about 74% of five-year operating profit; the 2022 rate order set a 9.25% allowed return on equity, gas costs passed through. **Q2 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: no rival could lay a second main, so the castle stands today, but its ten-to-twenty-year life turns on New York's treatment of gas under the CLCPA, which the filer says is "difficult to predict" and depends on "regulatory treatment", and which the company's 2024 rate case already prices as shorter service lives; the 2021 order cut base rates on pandemic-austerity grounds below the regulator's staff recommendation. Q3 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, facts recorded, not weighed: owner cash (operating cash less stock pay, all capital spending and acquisitions; `tools/run.py` missed the stock pay, corrected from the filed statements) FY2017 to FY2021 -2.92, -2.17, -0.26, -5.22, -6.84 ($M), average -3.48 (all-equity basis -1.59); capital spending 2.1 to 2.7 times depreciation every year; assets $55.0M to $144.1M and long-term debt $13.5M to $46.1M FY2013 to FY2021, equity $23.4M to $35.5M mostly from new shares (2.26M to 3.08M); the 10-K names no rival, RGC Resources and ONE Gas chosen as a CONVENTION of the run (average return on equity Corning 7.4%, falling to 4.3% in FY2021, RGC 10.0%, ONE Gas 7.9%); **integrity facts recorded, not judged**: a company related to two directors (Mirabito) held a change-of-control option to buy the Leatherstocking NY stake for $100,000 and exercised it during the pending merger; change-in-control agreements extended in January 2022 while the merger was pending; against them modest pay (CEO $282K) and a go-shop that contacted 64 parties. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: value range -$36.44 a share all-equity (the no-growth case alone, the cash series changing sign; net debt $78.15M at 2022-03-31 counting the Series A, C and D preferred the company books as debt, Series B deducted on top), fair price -$32.11 all-equity (-$12.92 equity-only); on the depreciation variant range -$7.80 all-equity and +$6.21 equity-only, fair -$16.56 and +$2.63; no price to set them against; not armed. Contamination declared by the analyst: the opening `git log` subjects naming the CLNE run and one filtered `Test Runs/` listing for this name returning nothing, none used. Commits cadf8090 (template), eef4c1a3 (Step 0), b5043a48 (Q1), ca264aae (Q2), e8f6f655 (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 27 ids, no E-ids, 17 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): no rule for a name that cannot be bought (Q7 and Q8 close on a price, so Q7 could never close IN; a one-line Step 0 rule suggested); stale filings five years old and a fact taken from the company's website; Q2's regulated-return exception has no test for the regulator itself as the threat (another analyst could pass Q2 and carry the name to Q7); the owner-cash range values a regulated rate base earning about 9% at less than nothing; redeemable preferred booked as debt and convertible preferred in temporary equity under the all-equity basis. Queue note: the name has been private since 2022-07-06, so its place on the operator's sheet was stale.
